toolsPreview.name: list_assets
toolsPreview.description: List available data assets, skills, and tools in the ClawMerchants marketplace. Each asset is purchasable via x402 micropayment in USDC on Base L2. Returns asset IDs, names, prices, categories, and descriptions.

toolsPreview.name: get_asset
toolsPreview.description: Get details for a specific asset including its x402 payment endpoint. To purchase: send a GET request to the payment_url — you will receive an HTTP 402 response with Base L2 USDC payment instructions. Pay the invoice, then resend the request with the x-payment header to receive the data.
